claim_one_line: THE TRADE-OFF IS NOT IN THE COUPLING'S FORM (PROVED by an explicit example; data-free; P-879): under the charge rule, with both sectors' channels free, a nearly null Higgs of reality 0.003 gives an aligned mixing (diagonal |V| 0.967, 0.901, 0.915) with heavy-pair ratios 4.6e-3 (up) and 1.7e-3 (down) and three distinct non-zero masses in each sector, recomputed at 50 digits; the least heavy-pair ratio compatible with alignment 0.9 rises from 4.6e-3 at reality 0.003 to about 0.4 above 0.7, and alignment is impossible exactly at 0 (B1966); so the exclusion B1965 found at four points of frame C must come from the channels the frame produces, and P-879 is whether they ever reach the tuned region. 0 of 19.
